description: This file defines the Category class in the Goteo project, pertaining to project categories. It includes methods for retrieving categories, validating, saving, and removing category-project associations, and interacts with a database via PDO.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: PHP class representing project categories, with methods to get categories, validate, save, and remove category associations.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields ('name', 'description') that are language-dependent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a given project ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all categories, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a specific project by name, with optional limit and language filtering.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Category object for required fields before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the category-project association into the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the association between a category and a project.
